explication: This repository provides Terraform templates and supporting scripts to provision public-cloud infrastructure for IBM Spectrum Scale clusters, then prepare installation configuration and optional remote mounts. Users choose a cloud template; the templates provision infrastructure, while the inventory utilities translate Terraform outputs into Spectrum Scale/Ansible inputs. The README documents AWS, Azure, and IBM Cloud usage; the tree also contains GCP templates. The sampled sources show inventory and file-generation behavior, but not Terraform module wiring or a complete deployment orchestrator.
